opportunities.name: Tech lead research: HN + GitHub to note
opportunities.description: For a given tech project name, find its HN story stats (via HN/Algolia search) and GitHub repo stars and latest release, then save a 'Lead' note.
steps: Search project name on Hacker News (Algolia) and read top story title, points, age
Search project name in GitHub search bar and open top repo
Read stars and last release date
Open Notes, click New note, type 'Lead: <name>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>' and press Enter
